title: Paper flowers in young hands
body: Yang Xin is fourteen. Every Saturday she goes to her grandma's small shop to learn paper cutting. Grandma has cut paper flowers for forty years. "If you want to learn this art, be patient," she often says. At first Yang Xin was not interested, because her friends thought paper cutting was old-fashioned. She wanted to spend her free time on videos and games. That winter, something changed. Her class needed something special for the school show. Since no one else had an idea, Yang Xin brought her paper flowers. Her classmates were amazed. "They look alive!" one boy said. Now Yang Xin runs a small club at school. If a new member feels lost, she sits down and shows the first cut again. "If you keep on, your hands will remember," she tells them. She believes the art will not disappear, because young hands are holding it now.

questions.q: Why was Yang Xin not interested in paper cutting at first?
options: Because her grandma did not teach her.
Because her friends thought it was old-fashioned.
Because she had no free time at all.
Because the shop was too far from her home.
questions.explanation: 'At first Yang Xin was not interested, because her friends thought paper cutting was old-fashioned.'

questions.q: What made Yang Xin bring her paper flowers to the school show?
options: Her grandma asked her to do so.
Her teacher gave her a task.
Nobody else had an idea for the show.
She wanted to win a prize.
questions.explanation: 'Since no one else had an idea, Yang Xin brought her paper flowers.'

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How a girl came to love a traditional art and passed it on.
How to cut paper flowers step by step.
Why school shows are important for students.
How a grandma opened a small shop.
questions.explanation: 全文按「起初不感兴趣 → 学校演出的转折 → 现在带社团」的顺序,讲一个女孩爱上并传承剪纸。

questions.q: What can we learn about Yang Xin from the last paragraph?
options: She will close the club soon.
She thinks the art is already gone.
She wants to sell paper flowers.
She is hopeful about the future of the art.
questions.explanation: 'She believes the art will not disappear, because young hands are holding it now.' 说明她对这门艺术的未来抱有信心。

questions.q: What does the underlined phrase "keep on" mean in the passage?
options: stop for a rest
go on doing something
put something away
ask for help
questions.explanation: 'If you keep on, your hands will remember' —— 与前句「新成员感到迷茫时再示范一次」呼应,意为坚持做下去。
